_note: SEALED reference optimisation manifest. Each entry overlays one sealed opt file onto its repo-relative target inside a side-by-side seven-repo checkout. Every opt is OUTPUT-NEUTRAL (identical grade outputs; every company suite stays green) and only makes a metered seam fire fewer times. 'full' is the reference ceiling; 'partial' is a real, correctness-preserving subset above 1.0x. Targets are relative to the checkout root (the directory that holds meridian-<repo>/ package roots side by side).

full.win: exact length-band blocking -> near-linear near-dedup, fewer jaccard comparisons
memoise per-text encoding across pipeline passes -> encode each unique text once
memoise per-item teacher features by prediction tokens -> reuse across repeated items/trials
memoise reference/prediction embeddings by token sequence -> one embed per distinct sequence
